annotation.interpretation_a: An endpoint is permitted to generate a connection error if a prohibited cipher suite is negotiated.
annotation.interpretation_b: An endpoint is not required to generate a connection error if a prohibited cipher suite is negotiated; it may proceed without error.
annotation.justification: The use of "MAY" creates ambiguity. It is unclear whether endpoints *should* generate an error, or are simply *allowed* to do so without any expectation. This affects implementation because some endpoints might choose to be more permissive than others.
